source: Original built-in imagegen; elevation reference used for painted limestone style. No pixel post-edits, only WebP conversion.

integration.placement: Use ONE uniform similarity transform mapping lowerFoot to world lower landing and upperFoot to upper landing. Apply same transform to walk polygon and silhouetteclip. Never stretch x/y independently.
integration.limitation: Generator retained faint golden alpha glow outside physical stone despite targeted cleanup. Use physicalSilhouetteClip_pixel before drawing; no halo should enter scene. Exact silhouette trace is conservative and requires browser QA.
integration.widthAtWorldLength4_5: Walk corridor approx1.4world wide. For1.8width use~5.8worldlength uniformly; do not distort to force both dimensions.
integration.anchorAccuracy: visually traced actual generated treads/landings, not theoretical requested angle; browser footcontact required.

prompt: Independent softly painted warm limestone stair sprite;8–10broadwalkabletreads, low edging, clearupper/lowerlandings, bottomslightlyleft to top slightlyright, highoverheadoblique, upperleftlight, alpha/no wood/ladder/scenery/text. Requested11degree axis; actual~19degrees, compensated using similarity transform.
